mutations.because: Placing EVERY clock on the whole-creative ruler is the obvious simplification, and it is wrong in a way nothing else catches: a beat-clock stop t is beat-LOCAL, so at 0.5 it fires at the midpoint of every beat and has no single second to sit at. One diamond would claim a position the renderer never uses, and dragging it would write a t meaning something else entirely. The ruler would look complete and lie. Caught by the test asserting beat and effect stops are counted rather than placed.
